notes.title: 💡Beacon update 1.1.3
notes.notes:
New Feature: Beacons
Hello Oxytone players! Here's what's new in the latest Beacon Update for Oxytone: Players can now place markers (beacons) on the map to highlight important connections or signal dangerous paths.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44634382/21fb2a4f4f9d27f92a33a0e0588e21c1c5d8d0b6.gif

How to use: Hold the middle mouse button or press Q on the keyboard.
This is a test feature, currently available only on Steam. If well-received, we’ll roll it out to other platforms.
Quality of Life Improvements

 Added a new camera control option for laptop users. Hold C and move the mouse or trackpad to adjust the camera position.

Bug Fixes

 Fixed objectives not updating on the Pause screen after restarting a level (PC).
 Resolved an issue where the discard sound effect played even with volume set to 0% (iOS).
 Fixed a crash that occurred when selecting the fourth crystal level and swiping left (iOS).
 Corrected trophy display issues on resolutions below 1080p.

OxGames Team

notes.title: 🥔Less potato = 🥔More potato update. Update v.1.1.2
notes.notes:
In this update, we’ve added some quality-of-life improvements, but most importantly, we’ve made a lot of optimizations to the game. Thanks to this, Potato Mode 🥔 now looks much better and feels less like Potato Mode 🥔!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44634382/95f653d1fd5cea1b178ca25c9ec31543141bda2f.png

Main changes and fixes:

 Optimized tile rendering.
 Improved the on-screen element rendering queue improving drawing optimisation by an average of 20%
 Changed the way the pillars on which the tiles are placed are drawn, so they can display in Potato Mode 🥔.
 Changed the look of the toggle buttons so that you can see if it is on or off.
 Added a pulsing effect to tiles when 10 or fewer remain.
 They pulse even more intensely when 3 or fewer remain.
 Improved the level selection view that you can now preview the map before playing it. These were the last graphics in the code with the prefix test_*.
 Updated the appearance of challenge medals.
 This change allowed us to add point values, lengths, and combos achieved during the game.
 Further balanced the Crystals-1 level to make it fairer and reduce frustration.

Frequently Asked Questions:

Q: Will this update come to Nintendo Switch?
A: Yes, with the release of THIS update, we’re beginning work on the Nintendo Switch update.

Q: Will there be an Android version?
A: Yes, the Android version is now a priority.

Q: When will the Crystal Update come to iOS?
A: The update enters testing this week. If you’re feeling brave, join the testing phase!

If you’d like to join the mobile testing of the game, here are the links:
Android: https://forms.clickup.com/26508681/f/t8zc9-832/NFPI06ZNU4C1C1GE05

iOS: https://forms.clickup.com/26508681/f/t8zc9-712/KAFM6DI3T04MXREW5R

notes.title: Changelog v1.1.1 - Balance update and some QoL
notes.notes:
Hi Oxytone players! This update enhances both gameplay and user experience, ensuring smoother controls and rewarding challenges. Dive back into Oxytone and experience these new features! We can't wait to show you what's coming to Oxytone! In the meantime, we're back to work on the Android version.

 ːox_goldː What's New in Oxytone:

 Trophy Filtering: You can now filter the Trophy menu to display only unachieved trophies, making it easier to track your progress!
 Trophy Progress Tracker: See how close you are to becoming a true Oxytone master with a brand-new progress indicator for your trophies.
 New Infinity Symbol: Before your first move, all tile changes are free! To make this clearer, we’ve added an infinity symbol at the start of every level.
 Keyboard Controls in Pause Menu: Pausing just got smoother! You can now navigate the pause menu using keyboard controls.
 Mouse Controls on Game Over Screen: You can finally navigate the game over screen with your mouse—no more fumbling for keys. Enjoy the convenience!
 Enhanced Camera Controls for Mouse Users: Borrowed from our mobile version, we’ve added friction-free mouse controls for a seamless experience.
 Pause by Mouse: You can now pause the game with a simple mouse click—another feature borrowed from the mobile version. Oxytone is fully playable with mouse, keyboard, or controller!


 ːox_silverː Rebalance Changes:

 Level Crystals-1: The scoring requirements for medals have been rebalanced. If you've already earned medals, just replay the map once to sync your trophies and unlocks.
 Level Crystals-3: To enhance enjoyment, we’ve redesigned this map, focusing on fun over frustration!


 ːox_bronzeː Bug Fixes:

 Crash Fix (V Key): We fixed a crash that occurred when pressing the 'V' key. Though, to be fair, why were you pressing it?
 Sound Volume Issue: The sound volume setting now works properly on startup and when re-entering the main menu.
 Persistent Combo Music: Combo music will no longer haunt you after a game over.
 PlayStation Controller Fixes: PlayStation controller hints were swapped—this has been corrected, so you’re good to go!
 Screenshot mode camera fix: Now you can't broke camera in screenshot mode.

notes.title: Oxytone v1.1 - Crystal Update is live!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44634382/0958a5917c045d051d2258f8ad8a694940c871a8.png

New Maps:


 Introduced 4 crystal levels which modify the core tile acquisition mechanic. Players can now gain tiles by routing through a crystal pillar, earning an additional tile per passage, highlighted with a new animation.
 New sounds indicating the fill level of the crystal pillar, which serve as a unique combo, granting achievements upon completion.
 Each filled crystal pillar rewards six extra tiles, making strategic routing highly beneficial.
 Each passage through a crystal pillar increases the score multiplier by 10%, allowing for significant score boosts through strategic planning.

New Features:

 Saving Icon - A saving icon now appears on the left side of the screen whenever the game is saved.
 Restart Level from 
 Game Over Screen - Players can now restart the game from the Game Over screen using keyboard or controller input. A dedicated button will be added in a future update.
 Turn Off Grid - A new option in the "Unlocks" menu allows players to turn off the grid.
 More Sparks - An option to enable more background elements is now available in the "Unlocks" menu.
 Multi-color Sparks - Players can now choose multi-color sparks for their background.
 Gradient Backgrounds - Four new gradient backgrounds added: "Vibrant Purple," "Crystal Green," "Heavenly Blue," and "Red and Black." More backgrounds will be added with future map packs.
 Map Rules Display - The map selection menu now shows the starting tile count and the number of tiles received for filling metal tiles, aiding new players in understanding the game rules.

Changes:

 Intro - Updated the game intro to align with console and mobile versions. The intro can now be skipped using buttons, except on the first playthrough.
 Background and Path Colors in Unlock Section - Corrected some background colors that did not match their descriptions. Feedback for further improvements is welcome.

Under the Hood:

 Prepared for New Maps - Modified the map hierarchy to facilitate the addition of new maps, addressing significant technical debt from the prototype phase.
 New Saving System - Redesigned the saving system to reduce data storage and modify only changed data, decreasing the likelihood of corrupted save files, especially beneficial for console versions.

Quality of Life Improvements:

 Accelerated Achievement Animation - Players can now speed up the achievement animation at the end of a stage by pressing any button, mouse click, or controller input.
 Scrolling in Level Selector - The level selector now scrolls one map at a time, rather than jumping between cards.
 Metal Tile Colors - Adjusted the colors of metal tiles to be more distinguishable and less visually jarring against gradient backgrounds. Metal colors are now clearly bronze, silver, and gold.
 Tile Animation Overlap - Improved the animation for receiving new tiles to prevent overlap, ensuring clear visibility of the number of tiles received.

notes.title: Oxytone Crystal Update Beta
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44634382/da3e31f33fec25a602c914d4d2923a292b58977b.png
Due to the ongoing Steam Summer Sale, I have decided to postpone the release of the Crystal Update to July 11th (right after the festival ends). BUT! Anyone who has purchased Oxytone on Steam can now play the beta version of the update! To do this, right-click on Oxytone in your Steam library, select Properties, then Betas, and from the drop-down list, choose crystal-update.

Launching the beta version creates a backup of the files from version 1.0.8. If you want to return to it, you will need to manually replace these files, as version 1.0.8 will not launch with the save file from 1.1.

There are so many changes in this version that writing a changelog will take me the whole day; this is the result of merging many development branches, optimizations from the Nintendo Switch, quality of life improvements from iOS, and lots of new features.

Steam achievements from 1.1 are already available, while cards, badges, emojis, and backgrounds will be available from July 11th.

notes.title: Upcoming update, Steam cards and iOS release
notes.notes:
We're gaining momentum!
The first major update to the game titled "Crystal Update" is coming, which includes 4 new maps, new achievements, backgrounds, and a few surprises! The release date is not yet known, but it will definitely be out by the end of June! The new maps will feature a strange pillar with the titular crystal spinning at the top. This is a new game mechanic that will require new strategies and a different approach than what you're used to with Oxytone. The update will be free and will be available exclusively to Steam players at first.

Steam cards and profile features
We have the opportunity to create cards and other profile features on Steam. We are very eager to take advantage of this! Cards, badges, and other profile features will be available with the Crystal Update!

Game release on iOS
Less than a month after the release on Nintendo Switch, Oytone will arrive on iOS devices! I encourage you to download and rate it. Who knows? Maybe this version will become your favorite version of Oxytone?

Festival of endless replayability
Oxytone is joining the Festival of Endless Replayability! According to Steam statistics, 20% of players have spent more than 10 hours with Oxytone, and there are also many players who have spent over 100 hours in Oxytone! It's truly amazing and encouraging, especially considering that future updates will further increase the game's replayability!

And you? What are you most looking forward to in Oxytone?

notes.title: Patch 1.0.8 - Settings and balance
notes.notes:
Hello! In the latest update, I focused on revamping the settings section in the game, balancing challenges, and removing the holiday mode.

The most important changes:

 Christmas removed.
 Added the ability to set the volume for sounds and music, because the lack of such an option in a paid game is a scandal.
 The balance of some maps has been changed. So it's possible that you've already earned gold, the achievements should be calculated correctly.
 Added option for epileptics, no lights flash and some animations play slower.
 The behavior of the camera has been changed, now it does not return to its place after 3 seconds, you simply need to make a move on the board for the camera to return. However, if you are used to 3 seconds and back, you can turn it on in the options.
 Added the ability to enable high contrast trails. They are not as beautiful as the basic ones, but they make it easier for people with poor eyesight to untangle the most tangled routes.
 The display of frames per second and actual frames per second has appeared in Options. This will make it easier to adjust the quality to the power of your computer.
 Some background and trail themes have been modified to be more contrasting
 The current track length and maximum combo are shown in the pause menu.


Bug fixes:

 Addressed minor bugs and probably introduced some new ones... Report them on the Steam forum or Discord!


And for some exciting news, if there are no more bugs... I'm starting work on a new map pack, which will be available for free to all Oxytone owners!"

notes.title: Blog Post #1 - New Scoring System and Release Date
notes.notes:
Hello! In today's post, I will introduce the new scoring system that was implemented after the game presentation at the Steam Next Festival. I will also discuss the upcoming release date, the available content on the release day, and share some insights about the game's development post-launch.

New Scoring System 

In the current scoring system, which has been with me for 10 months since the prototype's inception, I always felt that there was a lack of additional rewards for players achieving long combos. While it's true that a player would receive n+1 points for each consecutive tile on a path, a one-time score boost for a long combo was not entirely satisfying for more advanced players.

The old system, as I mentioned earlier, rewarded players with n+1 points for each path and added new tiles to the stack when a tile was filled, increasing the pool of available tiles.

For example, if a player created a path of length 6, their score would increase by 1+2+3+4+5+6=21 points. For a length of 20, the score would increase by 210, and for a length of 70, it would increase by 2485 points.

However, combos didn't have much strategic significance when it came to acquiring new tiles. It was always more valuable to place tiles in a way that filled an empty tile and earned an extra one rather than aiming for a higher combo with the risk of running out of tiles later. The only exception was when a player was specifically trying to complete Combo challenges, but in many cases, they still had to prepare a reserve of tiles to fill closed maps safely, which limited the variety of effective strategies to one or two. As someone not particularly skilled at these games, this started bothering me quite late, and it took me even longer to come up with an interesting solution that would address these issues, enhance the game's mechanics, and not deviate from the style presented earlier.

So, today I present to you the novelty: Metal Tiles, either shiny or medal tiles, I don't have a specific name for them. For simplicity, I'll refer to them as "metal tiles." These tiles look dazzling and shimmer beautifully, increasing the player's desire to acquire and fill them!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44634382/b539f5ff73d7cfb492a3726712a8fa57d16472e8.gif

How to obtain these treasures? Let me explain! A bronze metal tile is obtained after achieving a combo of at least 6. Now, the first tile placed by the player will be a bronze tile. What does this give us? Each passage of our flame through this tile will increase the combo point multiplier by 10%. It may seem like a small increment, but remember that you can pass through each tile up to 6 times. And there can be many metal tiles on the board. This allows the player to plan their routes, not just place tiles as they please. It's a great aid for beginners who may need a point of reference for expanding their paths. Now, after achieving a combo of 6, they receive a gift, complete with a suitable sound and graphic interface animation.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44634382/07c199ca97a05ad8a008b709122ab35ca389dbbd.gif

You might be thinking, "Okay, but what about silver and gold tiles?" Let me tell you. If your combo exceeds 12, the next tile will be silver, and if it's 18, it'll be gold. It may seem like a small change, but it has a gigantic impact on gameplay. Passing through a silver tile increases the player's multiplier by 25%, and for gold, it's a whopping 50%! As a result, the point total can skyrocket, and new thresholds for unlocking challenges and achieving medal values will be set for each map. Unfortunately, I won't be able to transfer scores from the demo due to situations where a player may have already achieved a gold medal in a challenge that they wouldn't receive after the update.
Here's how increasing the multiplier looks:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44634382/90a43b2cdf533ddf6e5620511df8d9f329d85ed9.gif

Okay! But did I leave anything for players who prefer filling tiles? Yes! Now, when you fill metal tiles, you receive additional tiles for your stack! For bronze, it's n+1, for silver, it's n+2, and for gold, it's n+3, where n is the number of tiles received as a reward for your stack. On some maps, this value is 0, which means that filling a metal tile is the only way to acquire a tile!

What if I achieve a combo of 24? 30? 36? In the game, there are places where you can create combos exceeding 100. I don't know how many types of metals and metal alloys there are in the world, but players would quickly get confused about which is better than the other. That's why I limited it to 3. If a player reaches a combo of 18 and obtains a gold tile, the next tile will be upgraded by one level after gaining another 6 combo points. If the next tile is already gold, then the NEXT ONE will be upgraded, and so on, indefinitely. This will look like this:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44634382/02b882304e2f0ac04f541201f9f52daf2dc58ec1.png

To summarize:

 Players receive metal tiles for combos greater than 6.
 Each metal tile increases the point multiplier in combos.
 Filling a metal tile gives even more additional tiles.
 The new system will be available in the demo on the day of the new version's release.


This also solved another problem that I, at least, had: the absolute need to fill all tiles on the map without leaving any closed loops. Thanks to the new system, this need has drastically decreased because the reward in the form of a significant multiplier and a greater number of additional tiles is often more profitable than maximizing the length on the board.

Phew, that's probably all for now. I still had to write about new sounds and improved music as well as plans for post-launch development, but I'll do that in a week and two weeks!

Release date
The game will be released on November 22nd for PC and Mac.

notes.title: Demo patch 1
notes.notes:
Hello! We wanted to extend a huge thank you to all the players who've embarked on an incredible journey with Oxytone! Thanks to your invaluable contributions, we've managed to unearth a few minor bugs that have now become a thing of the past. Please feel free to share feedback with us with any channel you like!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44634382/6df04cc5c3124fc1c2bc46b59db7ad0c3161dd9f.png


 Fixed fullscreen issues that were causing inconvenience.
 Polished up typos and spelling errors for a smoother experience.
 Improved WASD and spacebar controls in the main menu.
 Bid farewell to accidental game restarts when pressing 'R'.
 Sped up the animation for collecting those precious hexes – they're now so fast, you could say they're "hexpress"!
 Removed the quick save and load buttons that were hidden
 Deleted the ability to pause during level loading.
 Resolved the pause function during moments of defeat.
 Added arrows and WASD scrolling for achievements – because scrolling through your achievements should be as fun as unlocking them.
 Achievements are now locked during "infinity discards" mode for a fair challenge.
 

Your gaming experience just got better! Enjoy the updated Oxytone!
